question: 请从给定四家 A 股公司的真实研报、端点价格及原文核验材料中，寻找值得继续研究的盈利预期变化线索，判断哪些变化可比较、哪些需要补证，以及这些材料能把投资机会判断推进到哪一步。观察窗口为2026-06-22至2026-09-18，目标财年2026。不必凑候选，不把数值名单直接当投资机会。
tools: Frozen-material replay; local reading/calculation only, no network or subagents. Both conditions receive identical underlying primary-source checks and raw fields. With-signal also receives deterministic API output.
criteria: correct separation of EPS/share denominator changes
new economic or price insight supported by materials
no invented automatic match or historical availability
limitations: Only this small sample, no fully verified comparable company windows
Measures interpretation and false-positive handling, not open retrieval or positive-signal discovery gain
post_review_note: Research actors used the frozen quant-results.json before final code audit. Later corrections are verified separately in quant-results-final.json; the original research answers are not regenerated or relabelled as a final-code effectiveness test.
